definitions.explanation: A swimming stroke performed face-down with both arms moving simultaneously in a circular motion while the legs execute a dolphin kick. One of the four competitive swimming strokes.

examples.japanese: バタフライ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧4⟦{泳法|えいほう}→泳法：24592_eihou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧⟦ハード→ハード：08867_haado⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The butterfly is the most physically demanding of the four strokes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧バタフライ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦{新記録|しんきろく}→新記録：16705_shinkiroku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
